findings.reason: The evidence shows the alarm and latency spikes, but does not prove the DNS timeout caused the nationwide latency or that it resulted in complaints.
The cited evidence explicitly states the alarm was raised at 14:38 and cleared at 16:11 on CORE-DNS-01.
T8 shows latency peaks for all four regions occurred between 14:30 and 15:30 (e.g., SUD max at 14:30, SAH/SFX max at 14:45).
T2 explicitly reports no changes on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents within the specified time window.
T3 explicitly reports no maintenance windows scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents within the specified time window.
T9 explicitly reports no external events for all regions between 12:00 and 18:00, covering the incident window.
